sections.label: s1
sections.text: Every release starts as a clean plan.

sections.label: s2
sections.text: Four tasks, two days each, and the launch sits on day eight.

sections.label: s3
sections.text: Then testing takes five days instead of two. Nothing moves yet. But every task after it slides, and the launch misses its date by three days.

sections.label: s4
sections.text: The plan was fine. The estimate was not.
